scope: Proposed workflow evaluation protocol; not a certification standard

stages.name: Contract checks
checks: Correct proposed tool and asset identity
Cost and latency routing against supplied constraints

stages.name: Sandbox tool execution
checks: Execute approved calls against disposable fixtures
Reopen editable source and exported artifact
Verify downstream state and induced-failure recovery
Capture end-to-end time and actual usage

stages.name: Independent quality review
checks: Human-authored rubric and adjudicated calibration set
Candidate never approves its own work
Freeze judge version, rubric and pair ordering policy

stages.name: Production promotion
checks: Workload owner approves quality, p95 latency and budget thresholds before a run
No critical data-boundary or unauthorized-write failures
Representative repeated runs and uncertainty reported
Limited canary, rollback route and ongoing failure sampling
